text:
maya: spotted billing hole: token-exchange requests show up as "no project" in console and skip quota.
aj: confirmed. proxy removes project claim during the exchange. router uses claims.project_id so attribution fails.
leo: only the exchange path? console-minted keys look fine.
sam: yes, repro with service->proxy->exchange.
maya: short-term: tag telemetry with project_missing=true and map to org fallback in billing pipeline. show console badge: "Org-attributed (audit)" instead of hiding.
aj: add feature flag auth.reject_on_missing_project for Dedicated customers who want strict mode.
leo: small proxy change: preserve x-original-project header before exchange so we can reconcile later.
ops-bot: Tickets created: ENG-15002 (pipeline fallback), ENG-15003 (feature flag).
aj: I'll own pipeline + alert for project_missing spikes.
leo: I'll add e2e for token-exchange path verifying telemetry and console badge.
maya: I'll write the RFC proposing claim-preservation at proxy as long-term fix and the console copy + support playbook.
sam: also ensure billing export includes fallback tag for finance.
leo: agreed. triage done. :thumbsup:
